title: Query filters and laziness
description:
Milestone 4 of the Local Store Initiative (implements the @wip specs in features/02_querying/): filters by source, project, part kind, and time window are pushed down to SQLite — the engine does the filtering; callers never pull every record into memory to compare properties (the 1.4 GB Claude trees and 6 GB Cursor stores make that unscalable). Laziness is proven, not assumed: taking one session opens only it, dropping an iterator stops the work, message iteration streams without materializing the session. Turns `02_filters.feature` and `03_laziness.feature` green and removes their @wip tags.

Every task in this epic: work in your own worktree off origin/develop (unique path, e.g. /tmp/botspy-<task-id>-<short>), branch `feat/store-<short>`, PR to develop only — never main (GitFlow). Log milestone comments on the task; close only when its DoD is met. Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
